title: Why LeBron James is the Greatest of All Time
text: LeBron James stands alone in NBA history as the only player in the 40,000+ points, 11,000+ rebounds, and 11,000+ assists club. Comparing him against a field of 400 NBA players shows how he combines unmatched scoring longevity with elite playmaking.
